build_qwen3_5_causal_lm: build a Qwen3.5 causal language model with dense MLP and configurable decoder layers
build_qwen3_5_moe_causal_lm: build a Qwen3.5 Mixture-of-Experts causal language model with sparse MoE blocks
build_qwen3_5_conditional_generation: build a Qwen3.5 vision-language conditional generation model with multimodal support
run_gated_delta_net_forward: run the Qwen3.5 GatedDeltaNet linear attention forward pass with fused QKVZ projection
run_qwen3_5_load_weights: run weight loading for Qwen3.5 models with packed checkpoint and expert mapping support
run_qwen3_5_moe_load_weights: run weight loading for Qwen3.5 MoE models with fused expert and shared expert support
create_qkvz_proj: create a merged QKVZ projection layer for Qwen3.5 linear attention with tensor parallelism
create_ba_proj: create a merged B/A projection layer for Qwen3.5 linear attention gating parameters
create_linear_decoder_layer: create a Qwen3.5 decoder layer with linear attention and layer communicator for MoE routing
create_attention_decoder_layer: create a Qwen3.5 decoder layer with full RadixAttention and QK normalization
